claims_and_derivations.claim: For dimensionless local coordinates, B has units energy*time^2, C energy, M=B^-1/2 C B^-1/2 time^-2. Positive determinant gives positive frequencies; zero determinant is marginal, negative determinant instability. Common-frequency squared splitting is 2|C12|/sqrt(B1 B2).
claims_and_derivations.conditions: Constant positive diagonal mass, quadratic potential, no gyroscopic coupling; pedagogical construction, not an exact QRPA reduction.

claims_and_derivations.claim: In an orthonormal same-I/same-parity two-state basis with rephased V>=0, atan2(2V,Delta)/2 supplies the full detuning branch; zero V and zero detuning leave an arbitrary degenerate basis. Minimum gap 2V assumes fixed V and a zero-detuning crossing.
claims_and_derivations.locator: sec-3-6 Eqs two-state-h through mixed-states; parent math controls
claims_and_derivations.conditions: Transition operators rephase with basis; no empirical identification from energy agreement alone.

claims_and_derivations.claim: The E2 interference term is 2cs Re(M1 M2*), which may vanish. B contains 1/(2Ii+1). The sum to a fixed final state is preserved by the stated unitary two-state rotation for fixed operator and same initial spin.
claims_and_derivations.conditions: Exact within the declared two-state model; real-nucleus omitted strength/operator changes need independent checks.

claims_and_derivations.claim: For rotational H, [H-prime,Jx]=0 and [H-prime,Jy±iJz]=∓hbar*omega_rot*(Jy±iJz). Rotating-frame spurious modes must be separated from physical normal modes. The generalized J-omega susceptibility is not automatically a unique scalar effective wobbling inertia.
claims_and_derivations.conditions: Full rotational invariance for algebra, compatible mean field/residual interaction/truncation for RPA implementation. Doubly stretched QQ is one model choice, not universal necessity.

claims_and_derivations.claim: At fixed low phonon number and away from soft modes, high-spin expansions may organize relative 1/I corrections. Anharmonic spectra do not uniquely diagnose shape-orientation mixing.
claims_and_derivations.locator: sec:3-6-5; earlier sec3.2 local rotor expansion
claims_and_derivations.conditions: No universal numerical correction or obligatory interpretation of any three bands.

claims_and_derivations.claim: Oi–Walker use TAC-HFB for selected164Hf and a separately assumed one-dimensional quantization; model space did not reproduce expected TSD deformation. The mass relation following a=Mw*omega^2/2 has a factor-two algebra concern; this is a task consistency observation, not an independent experimental refutation.

claims_and_derivations.conditions: Not TAC+GCM, no full collective mass calculation or measured absolute EM confirmation; S/A local labels are not parity quantum numbers.

claims_and_derivations.claim: Kvasil–Nazmitdinov compare gamma-softening and neutron alignment mechanisms in156Dy/162Yb within their cranked Nilsson+RPA implementation; pairing gaps use a phenomenological prescription near crossing.
